slides.title: 14 Larkspur Lane
slides.body: Three beds, a garden that faces west.
slides.notes: Thank them for coming. Say the street name, not the listing number.

slides.title: Light all afternoon.
slides.body: The kitchen and the garden take the sun from two until it sets.
slides.notes: This is the line they remember. Pause after it.

slides.title: What you get
slides.body:
Three bedrooms, two up
A study off the hall
Parking for two
School catchment: Hillview
slides.notes: Walk the list. Ask which room matters most to them.

slides.title: Offers over 640
slides.notes: Give the number once. Then be quiet.

slides.title: Want a second look?
slides.notes: Close the phone. The recap is already in their inbox.
